notes: Executor harness + grading: see README.md 'Skill evals'. Each eval instantiates fixtures/inventory-repo into a temp workdir with its own setup, then a fresh-context subagent executes skills/loop/SKILL.md as /flywheel:loop in that dir. Eval mode: phase gates are pre-approved (no human is present to sign off), the host task system and artifact publishing are unavailable, and git operations inside the workdir are pre-approved. Grade with: bash skills/loop/evals/check.sh <id> <workdir>. This is the only suite that runs a whole cycle, and therefore the only one where work's cycle telemetry exists at all.

evals.name: cycle-telemetry-and-atomic-commits
evals.prompt: /flywheel:loop implement the stock-level work item in WORK.md
evals.setup: cp -r skills/loop/evals/fixtures/inventory-repo "$W" && git -C "$W" init -q -b main && git -C "$W" -c user.email=e@e -c user.name=e add -A && git -C "$W" -c user.email=e@e -c user.name=e commit -qm seed
evals.expected_output: A completed cycle: the two functions implemented and green, one commit per task recorded on the telemetry line, and a JSONL whose commit shas are real git objects.
expectations: A cycle telemetry JSONL exists under .claude/flywheel/runs/ with at least two transition lines, each parsing as an object with ts and state
No line carries a tokens key (P18)
At least one transition records a commit sha, and every recorded sha resolves to a real commit in the workdir
No commit mixes .py source with .claude/flywheel/ state, and no .py change is left uncommitted
restock merges into the existing item and rejects a non-positive qty; low_stock returns the below-threshold names in order; the suite is green on an independent re-run

evals.name: no-repo-fail-open
evals.prompt: /flywheel:loop implement the stock-level work item in WORK.md
evals.expected_output: The same cycle in a workdir that is not a git repository: the work still lands and the telemetry is still written, with no commit sha recorded and none invented.
expectations: A cycle telemetry JSONL exists under .claude/flywheel/runs/ with at least two transition lines, each parsing as an object with ts and state
No line carries a tokens key (P18)
No transition records a commit sha — there was nothing to commit, and a sha must not be fabricated
restock merges into the existing item and rejects a non-positive qty; low_stock returns the below-threshold names in order; the suite is green on an independent re-run
